text: गते गते पारगते पारसंगते बोधि स्वाहा
meaning: "Gone, gone, gone beyond, gone altogether beyond, O what an awakening, all-hail!" (Edward Conze, 1958). The closing mantra of the Heart Sutra, the shortest of the Perfection of Wisdom teachings.
purpose: To rest in letting go, and in what lies beyond holding on.
when: At the close of meditation; in times of change.
note: Chanted daily across Mahayana Buddhism, in Sanskrit, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese and Tibetan.
source: Prajñāpāramitā Hṛdaya (the Heart Sutra); translation: Edward Conze, 1958
name: Heart Sutra Mantra
iast: gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
pronunciation: ga-tay ga-tay paa-ra-ga-tay paa-ra-sam-ga-tay bo-dhi svaa-haa
